title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
summary: A Harvard symbologist is called to the Louvre after a curator is found murdered, with a cryptic message left beside the body. He and a French cryptologist race across Europe decoding clues tied to a secret about the Church.
readIf: you want a short-chapter, cliffhanger-driven chase built on puzzles, codes and art history.
skipIf: you mind thin characterisation or want the history to be strictly accurate.

pairings.reason: The earlier Robert Langdon adventure, set in Rome and with the same clue-chasing structure.
A far denser and more learned mystery in a similar world of hidden texts and Church secrets.
Books, secrets and a city full of hidden history, with richer prose and more heart.
